topical_requirements.quote: A dentist or dental hygienist shall provide proof of current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification intended for health care providers at the time of renewal as provided by rule. Basic Life Support certification training taken as a requirement of this Section shall be counted for no more than 4 hours during each licensure period towards the continuing education hours under Section 16.1 of this Act.

available.quote: Any person who has been lawfully licensed to practice dentistry, including the practice of a licensed dental specialty, or dental hygiene in another state or territory ... may, upon payment of the required fee, be granted a license to practice dentistry, a dental specialty, or dental hygiene in this State

requirements.value: Applicant must have been lawfully licensed in another state or territory with standards at least equal to Illinois, or requirements substantially equivalent at the time of licensure; must have been lawfully engaged in the practice of dentistry for at least 2 years immediately preceding application; must deposit a duly attested certificate from the other state's Board certifying licensure and good moral character; must pay the required fee. 'Substantially equivalent' means graduation from an ADA-accredited dental college, passage of both parts of the National Board Dental Examination, and completion of a regional testing service examination.
requirements.quote: Any person who has been lawfully licensed to practice dentistry ... in another state or territory ... and who has been lawfully engaged in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene for at least 2 years immediately preceding the filing of his or her application to practice in this State and who shall deposit with the Department a duly attested certificate from the Board of the state or territory in which he or she is licensed, certifying to the fact of his or her licensing and of his or her being a person of good moral character may, upon payment of the required fee, be granted a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license, or in connection with applying for renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act, or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to habitual or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or other chemical agent or drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of rules of the Department of Public Health or Department of Nuclear Safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violations of the rules of the Department of Public Health or Department of Nuclear Safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees received for dental services with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the knowledge of the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for dental services with any person for bringing or referring a patient, except in regard to referral services as provided for under Section 45, or assisting in the care or treatment of a patient, without the knowledge of the patient or his or her legal representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding, or abetting a person not licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist or dental hygienist to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misrepresentations or false promises to influence, persuade, or induce dental patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade or induce dental patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional connection or association with another for the illegal practice of dentistry, or lending one's name to such illegal practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with or lending his or her name to another for the illegal practice of dentistry by another, or professional connection or association with any person, firm or corporation holding himself, herself, themselves, or itself out in any manner contrary to this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or seeking to obtain practice, money, or other things of value by false or fraudulent representations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or seeking to obtain practice, money, or any other things of value by false or fraudulent representations, but not limited to, engaging in such fraudulent practice to defraud the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for any crime that is a felony under Illinois law, or a misdemeanor whose essential element is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing for any crime, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that (i) is a felony under the laws of this State or (ii) is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a dental hygienist, dental assistant, or other person under supervision to perform any operation not authorized by this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a dental hygienist, dental assistant or other person under his or her supervision to perform any operation not authorized by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting more than 4 dental hygienists to be employed under supervision at any one time
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting more than 4 dental hygienists to be employed under his or her supervision at any one time.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules promulgated under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules promulgated under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of Section 45 relating to advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one ground for discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those in this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth within this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice as a dentist, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the dental assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skills which results in a dentist's inability to practice dentistry with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated irregularities in billing for services rendered to a patient.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each dental office in this State must develop and implement a written emergency medical plan, which shall include staff responsibilities and office protocol for emergency procedures.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures, as further specified in Section 17.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures, as further specified in Section 17.

value: Diagnosis, treatment, prescription, or operation for disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw
Managing or conducting a business where dental operations are performed
Performing dental operations of any kind
Using X-ray machines or X-ray films for dental diagnostic purposes
Extracting human teeth or correcting malpositions of human teeth or jaws
Diagnosing, treating, or removing stains, calculus, and bonding materials from human teeth or jaws
Using or administering local or general anesthetics in dental or oral treatment
Taking impressions or digital scans for final prosthetic or restorative work
Furnishing, supplying, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, or substitutes for natural teeth
Instructing students on clinical matters or performing clinical operations in dental curricula
methods_authorized.quote: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this Act: (1) Who represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose or diagnoses, treats, prescribes, or operates for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw

drug_authority.value: Dentists may use or administer local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or in any preparation incident to a dental operation. Dentists may also administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation with a permit from the Department. Dentists may dispense drugs or medicines in good faith with required labeling. Dentists may administer influenza vaccinations under specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: Who uses or administers local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or in any preparation incident to a dental operation of any kind or character

value: moderate sedation permit
deep sedation permit
general anesthesia permit
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No licensed dentist shall administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation without first applying for and obtaining a permit for such purpose from the Department.

specialist_license_available.quote: The Department shall issue a license authorizing practice as a specialist in any particular branch of dentistry to any dentist who has complied with the requirements established for that particular branch of dentistry at the time of making application.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry unless he or she is licensed to practice in that specialty of dentistry.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: any advertisement which announces the availability of endodontics, pediatric dentistry, periodontics, prosthodontics, orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, or oral and maxillofacial radiology by a general dentist or by a licensed specialist who is not licensed in that specialty shall include a disclaimer stating that the dentist does not hold a license in that specialty.

value: Supervision (dentist authorizes procedure, remains in dental facility while procedure is performed, approves work before patient dismissal)
General supervision (patient of record, dentist examines patient within one year, dentist authorizes procedures by notation in patient record, dentist need not be present)

Public health supervision (supervising dentist has written public health supervision agreement, allows treatment without dentist first examining patient or being present, for Medicaid-eligible or uninsured/low-income patients)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist or a dental assistant requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure, remain in the dental facility while the procedure is performed, and approve the work performed by the dental hygienist or dental assistant before dismissal of the patient

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "Public health supervision" means the supervision of a public health dental hygienist by a licensed dentist who has a written public health supervision agreement with that public health dental hygienist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist entering into an agreement under this Section may supervise and enter into agreements for public health supervision with 4 public health dental hygienists.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: "Public health dental hygienist" means a hygienist who holds a valid license to practice in the State, has 2 years of full-time clinical experience or an equivalent of 4,000 hours of clinical experience, and has completed at least 42 clock hours of additional structured courses in dental education in advanced areas specific to public health dentistry.

value: Patients eligible for Medicaid
Uninsured patients whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist who is certified as a public health dental hygienist may provide services to patients: (1) who are eligible for Medicaid or (2) who are uninsured and whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice dentistry or engage therein, or hold itself out as being entitled to practice dentistry, or furnish dental services or dentists

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any dentist who employs or engages the services of any dental laboratory to construct or repair, extraorally, prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other replacements for a part of a tooth, a tooth, or teeth, or who directs a dental laboratory to participate in shade selection for a prosthetic appliance, shall furnish such dental laboratory with a written prescription on forms prescribed by the Department

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist, or fabricated pursuant to his or her prescription, shall be marked with the name of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth systems and methodologies in dentistry and includes patient care and education delivery using synchronous and asynchronous communications under a dentist's authority as provided under this Act.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: administration of local anesthetics upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: administration and monitoring of nitrous oxide upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: a dental hygienist may engage in the placing, carving, and finishing of amalgam restorations only after obtaining formal education and certification as determined by the Department

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: A dental assistant may place, carve, and finish amalgam restorations, place, pack, and finish composite restorations, and place interim restorations if he or she

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Dental records required by this Section shall be maintained for 10 years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: ensure that the dentist has completed and maintains current certification in advanced cardiac life support or pediatric advanced life support and all persons assisting the dentist or monitoring the administration of general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation maintain current certification in Basic Life Support (BLS)

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: "Public health dental hygienist" means a hygienist who holds a valid license to practice in the State, has 2 years of full-time clinical experience or an equivalent of 4,000 hours of clinical experience, and has completed at least 42 clock hours of additional structured courses in dental education in advanced areas specific to public health dentistry.
